$description: The v12 lane's explorations: our own styles being tried inline, each marked at every use with // @carbon-explore <name> — <reason>. <ref>. Every one is resolved before its component graduates — adopted as a @carbon-proposal, or removed. Checked by exploration-ledger.

explorations.name: radius-field
explorations.rationale: Form fields take the one off-grid rung, between the 4dp extra-small step and the 8dp container, so a field reads as touchable but not as a button. Carbon decided fields at 4 (carbon#22812); tags take Carbon's 2/4. Explored in labs and proposed only after a side-by-side, on the Text Input tracker carbon#23227 (decided 2026-10-14).

explorations.name: corner-smoothing
explorations.rationale: Every rounded corner is a 40% superellipse, one constant for every rung; a plain border-radius is 0%. Carbon is silent on corner smoothing. The mixin publishes the constant as --cds-explore-corner-smoothing and draws nothing yet: how 40% maps to CSS corner-shape is unmeasured, and the reference must not invent it.

explorations.name: hover-emboss
explorations.value: raised: drop 0 2px 4px 0 black @0.20; inset 0 1px 0.5px 0 white @0.28; inset 0 -1px 0.5px 0 black @0.18
explorations.rationale: Hover and hit lift an interactive surface with a subtle emboss, paired with the blue reveal; rest and selected stay flat. Carbon's hover is a lightness step (#23376) and its shadows are a stub (#23135). Rendered with Carbon's $shadow, whose alpha is Carbon's (0.3 light, 0.8 dark) rather than ours; the top highlight uses $icon-on-color, white in all four themes, because Carbon has no highlight token.

explorations.name: elevated
explorations.rationale: A surface that genuinely floats (modal, menu, toast, a dragged item) takes one large soft shadow with an offset, never a zero-offset halo. Carbon's box-shadow mixin is 0 2px 6px $shadow. Rendered with Carbon's $shadow, so its alpha is Carbon's.

explorations.name: primary-rest
explorations.value: rest $text-primary fill / $text-inverse label; hover $button-primary-hover; active $button-primary-active; selected $button-primary
explorations.rationale: The primary button rests in the extreme neutral (near-black on light, near-white on dark) and reveals brand blue on hover, press and selected, so blue means the person is acting: the button half of "blue responds" (carbon#23484). Carbon's primary is blue at rest. Drawn from Carbon tokens only ($text-primary is #161616 / #f4f4f4, not pure black or white); pure values would be a @carbon-proposal if this persuades. Proposed upstream on carbon#23134 (decided 2026-10-14).
